EXPLORE LATTICE

One notebook, three moves

Every project moves through the same three motions. Switch tabs to see what each one looks like inside Lattice.

Capture
Connect
Export
Capture without friction
Drop in text, a link, or a file — Lattice keeps the original source attached to the note automatically.
Everything saves straight to your device; nothing uploads while you write.
A quick-capture flow turns a stray thought into a structured note in seconds.
source attached

HOW IT FITS TOGETHER

A three-step workflow

The same shape holds up whether you're tracking one lead or an entire project.

01
Capture

Save a note the moment you find something. Its source — a link, file, or reference — attaches automatically.

02
Connect

Link the note to related ones and drop it into a reusable project template so the shape of the project holds.

03
Export

Export to Markdown whenever you want a clean, portable copy — for a collaborator, an archive, or yourself.

PRICING

Two plans, one notebook

On your device. Notes are stored locally rather than on a remote server, so your working notebook stays with you.
